claims.text: AF + native valve dz (except rheumatic MS) or bioprosthetic valve >3 mo ago: a NOAC = an effective alt to VKA.
claims.quote: For patients with AF and native valve heart disease (except rheumatic mitral stenosis [MS]) or who received a bioprosthetic valve >3 months ago, a non-vitamin K oral anticoagulant (NOAC) is an effective alternative to VKA anticoagulation

claims.text: Mitral bioprosthesis: warfarin for 3–6 mo postop.
claims.quote: A mitral bioprosthetic valve requires anticoagulation with warfarin for 3 to 6 months postoperatively
